Class MessageService

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.service.MessageService
public class MessageService extends Object
Service for parsing and sending rich messages using Paper's Adventure API.

This service integrates MiniMessage formatting with optional PlaceholderAPI resolution. All text output in the action/requirement engine should go through this service to ensure consistent formatting and placeholder handling.

Resolution order:

  1. Custom placeholders from ExecutionContext ({key} format)
  2. PlaceholderAPI placeholders (%placeholder% format) — if available
  3. MiniMessage tag parsing (<tag> format)

Example:

MessageService messageService = new MessageService(dependencyService);
messageService.send(player, "<green>Hello {name}! Balance: %vault_eco_balance%",
    Map.of("name", "Steve"));

    • send

      public void send(org.bukkit.entity.Player player, String message, Map<String,String> customPlaceholders)
      Sends a rich message to a player.

      The message is parsed through the full resolution pipeline (custom placeholders → PlaceholderAPI → MiniMessage) and then sent to the player via Adventure's sendMessage().

      Parameters:
      player - the recipient
      message - the raw MiniMessage string
      customPlaceholders - custom key-value placeholders
